metadata.question: Does Kerala, India experience more rainfall between July and August 2018 compared to Sri Lanka?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) from 2018-07-01 to 2018-08-31 over Kerala (GAUL level1) and Sri Lanka (GAUL level0). If CHIRPS empty, fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated precipitation. 2. Masking strategy: Not applicable; precipitation products are analysis-ready (no cloud masking). 3. Logic: Validate collections non-empty (else C1), ensure valid pixel counts >0 (else C2), and check mean totals are finite and within plausible range [0, 5000] mm for 2 months (else C3). Compare area-averaged totals: if Kerala > Sri Lanka, answer A; else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const start = '2018-07-01'; const end = '2018-09-01'; // exclusive end -> covers July+August const gaul1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1'); const gaul0 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0'); const keralaFC = gaul1.filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Kerala') )); const sriFC = gaul0.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Sri Lanka')); const keralaCount = await keralaFC.size().getInfo(); const sriCount = await sriFC.size().getInfo(); if (!keralaCount || !sriCount) { console.log('Boundary fetch: Kerala features=' + keralaCount + ', SriLanka features=' + sriCount); console.log('C1'); return; } const kerala = keralaFC.geometry(); const sri = sriFC.geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let dataset = 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'; let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).select('precipitation'); let imgCount = await col.size().getInfo(); if (imgCount === 0) { // Fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated total precipitation (m). Convert to mm. dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR'; col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).select('total_precipitation_sum').map(img => img.multiply(1000).rename('precipitation')); imgCount = await col.size().getInfo(); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('Images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing const sumImg = col.sum().rename('precipitation'); // total mm over period const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}); const kerStats = await sumImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: kerala, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const sriStats = await sumImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: sri, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const kMean = kerStats ? kerStats.precipitation_mean : null; const kCount = kerStats ? kerStats.precipitation_count : 0; const sMean = sriStats ? sriStats.precipitation_mean : null; const sCount = sriStats ? sriStats.precipitation_count : 0; // 4. Validation console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}, Images: ${imgCount}`); if (!kCount || !sCount) { console.log(`Kerala pixels: ${kCount}, SriLanka pixels: ${sCount}`); console.log('C2'); return; } const invalid = (v) => (v === null || !isFinite(v) || v < 0 || v > 5000); if (invalid(kMean) || invalid(sMean)) { console.log(`Kerala mean(mm): ${kMean}, SriLanka mean(mm): ${sMean}`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Output stats and Final Answer console.log(`Kerala pixels: ${kCount}, mean_mm: ${kMean.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`SriLanka pixels: ${sCount}, mean_mm: ${sMean.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Difference (Kerala - SriLanka) mm: ${(kMean - sMean).toFixed(1)}`); if (kMean > sMean) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
